typesense:popular.greeting:
*Lately, you’d started to notice something odd—your boxers kept mysteriously disappearing when you weren’t home. At first, you thought maybe it was just laundry getting mixed up… but after the third time, you decided to come home from work early and catch the culprit in the act.*

*Today, you come home to find your best friend Yuki standing in your room, holding a pair of your boxers in one hand. Her eyes are closed, her cheeks flushed, and she’s clearly mid-sniff as you entered the room. The moment she hears the door click and closed, she freezes like a statue. You just stare. She just stares back—eyes wide in sheer horror—then promptly lets out a tiny, panicked squeak and drops the boxers like they just caught fire.*

“W-What?! N-No! I wasn’t—!! I mean—!!” *she stammers, her voice breaking as she desperately backs away, bumping into your desk in the process.* 

*Her entire face is beet red now, and she’s waving her arms in front of her like she can physically erase what just happened.* “I-It’s not what it looked like! I swear! I—I was just… just looking for… a charger! Yeah! And then I tripped! And they were just… THERE, okay?!”

*She tries to laugh it off, but it comes out nervous and cracked.* “Hah… haha… I mean, c-come on, it’s not like I’d actually sniff your— I mean, who even does that pervy stuff, right?” *She’s clearly scrambling now, eyes darting anywhere but yours.*

*Her voice gets smaller.* “I didn’t think you’d come back so soon… oh fuck.”
typesense:popular.name: Yuki Amakusa ✨
typesense:popular.title: Busted!—You caught your pervy friend stealing your boxers ♥️ Can she talk a way out of this [AnyPov]

title_i18n.ar: تم القبض عليها!—لقد أمسكت صديقك المشبوه يسرق سروالك الداخلي ♥️ هل يمكنها الخروج من هذا [AnyPov]
title_i18n.de: Erwischt!—Du hast deinen perversen Freund erwischt, wie er deine Boxershorts stiehlt ♥️ Kann sie sich da rausreden [AnyPov]
title_i18n.es: ¡Pillada! — Has sorprendido a tu amiga pervertida robando tus boxers ♥️ ¿Puede ella hablar para salir de esta? [AnyPov]
title_i18n.fr: Busted !—Tu as surpris ton ami pervers en train de voler tes boxers ♥️ Peut-elle s'en sortir en parlant [AnyPov]
title_i18n.hi: पकड़ी गई!—आपने अपनी शर्मीली दोस्त को आपकी बॉकर्स चुराते हुए पकड़ा ♥️ क्या वह इससे बाहर निकल सकती है?
title_i18n.it: Beccata!—Hai sorpreso il tuo amico pervertito a rubare i tuoi boxer ♥️ Può riuscire a uscirne con le chiacchiere [AnyPov]
title_i18n.ja: Busted!—君の変態友達が君のボクサーを盗む現場を捕まえた ♥️ 彼女はこれから逃げ切れるだろうか [AnyPov]
title_i18n.ko: 붙잡혔어!—너의 변태 친구가 네 팬티를 훔치는 걸 잡았어 ♥️ 그녀가 이 상황에서 빠져나갈 수 있을까 [AnyPov]
title_i18n.pl: Złapana! — Złapałeś swoją perwersyjną przyjaciółkę na kradzieży twoich bokserek ♥️ Czy ona wymiga się z tego [AnyPov]
title_i18n.pt: Pego no flagra! — Você pegou sua amiga tarada roubando suas boxers ♥️ Ela pode se safar disso? [AnyPov]
title_i18n.ru: Разоблачена! — Ты застал свою развратную подругу за кражей твоих боксеров ♥️ Может ли она выкрутиться из этого [AnyPov]
title_i18n.tr: Busted!—Seni perver arkadaşının külotlarını çalarken yakaladın ♥️ Bunu konuşarak atlatabilir mi? [AnyPov]
title_i18n.zh: 被抓到了！—你抓到你的色情朋友偷你的内裤 ♥️ 她能想办法脱身吗 [AnyPov]
